minor.issue: emergentintegrations.llm.chat.send_message internally calls SYNC litellm.completion(...) which blocks the asyncio event loop for the entire duration of the AI call (incl. internal retries on upstream 502). During this window (~60–180s in tests, since the LLM key returns 502/budget-exceeded and gets retried) ALL other HTTP requests to the backend return ingress 502. The background-task design helps the POST return fast, but polling GETs still 502 until the AI call finally errors out. Fix: wrap the sync call with asyncio.to_thread / loop.run_in_executor, OR use AsyncLlmChat if available. Also reduce litellm internal retries (num_retries=0). Tests currently work around this by tolerating 502 on poll, but real users will see ‘service unavailable’ banners during every AI window.

The endpoint filters out empty strings ({k:v for k,v in payload.items() if v != ''}) so admins have NO way to CLEAR a previously set key/secret via the API. Once a leaked secret is stored, the only way to delete it is direct DB access. Recommend treating empty string as 'set to empty' OR add an explicit DELETE endpoint.
razorpay_key_secret_masked falls back to plain '•••' for secrets of length ≤10 (no length hint, indistinguishable from unset).

Reduce litellm internal retries (num_retries=0 / max_retries=1) so budget-exceeded errors surface in <5s instead of >60s.

Rotate / top-up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — budget is still exhausted; every generation hits the fallback path. (Refund logic correctly compensates, so user impact is zero credits, but no real AI output is produced.)
Allow admins to CLEAR integration-keys via API (current empty-string-is-noop filter means leaked secrets can only be deleted in MongoDB).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/generations.py: asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=50) only works if the awaitable is truly async. emergentintegrations.send_message internally awaits but calls SYNC litellm.completion, so the timeout cannot actually interrupt the upstream call — the task runs to completion (~60–180s) regardless of timeout=50. Move to_thread() before wait_for to make the timeout effective and unblock the loop.
routers/admin.py:_mask: bullets-only fallback for short secrets is fine but lossy; consider returning length hint (e.g., '•••(8)') so admins can verify what's stored.

routers/admin.py update_integration_keys + update_site_config: filtering empty strings means admins cannot CLEAR a key — only overwrite with a non-empty value. Recommend an explicit null/None semantic.

routers/google_auth.py: HTTPException detail leaks the underlying google-auth exception message ('Invalid Google token: Invalid base64-encoded string …') — fine for debugging but consider sanitising for production.
videos.py:upload_video: still reads full file into memory (data = await file.read()) before size check — DoS risk for 1GB+ uploads. Pre-iteration_2 issue, unchanged.

rca of the issue: Polling 502 RCA — During the AI background task, all GET requests to backend return ingress 502 for the entire AI duration. Root cause: emergentintegrations.llm.chat._execute_completion calls SYNC litellm.completion(...) (not the async path), which blocks the asyncio event loop. Even though _process_generation is launched via asyncio.create_task(), once it awaits chat.send_message → litellm.completion (sync), uvicorn's single event-loop thread is blocked and cannot serve other requests; K8s ingress observes no response within 60s and returns 502. Reproduction: POST /api/generate-prompt, then immediately GET /api/generations/{id} → 502 until AI errors out. Mitigation: wrap send_message in asyncio.to_thread() OR use an async-native LLM client; additionally set num_retries=0 in litellm/LlmChat so upstream 502s surface immediately instead of retrying for >60s. Note: the refund logic itself works correctly — backend logs confirm 'Refunded 1 credit … for fallback generation gen_xxx' and credits return to 100.
